trellis.definition:
n. latticework used to support climbing plants
v. train on a trellis, as of a vine
trellis.translation:
n. 格构, 格子结构, 棚, 架, 棚架式拱道, 格子遮板, 格构遮板, 格构凉亭, 格构拱道
vt. 为...建棚架
[计] 框架, 格式结构

trellised.definition: v train on a trellis, as of a vine
trellised.translation: a. 成格状的,有格子架支撑的
